clue.text: Looks into note enclosing dress

explanation.definitionFit: To probe is to investigate or examine closely, which is what looking into something means.

clue.text: Looking happy, most of set wants to be naked

parts.note: a radio is a wireless set

explanation.walkthrough: 'most of' drops the O of RADIO; 'to be naked' strips WANTS to ANT.

clue.text: Evidence of embarrassment as president embraces student

L is a learner, as on a learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: A student goes red when hugged by the president.
explanation.definitionFit: Reddening of the face is the visible sign of embarrassment.

clue.text: Finishes after rent is shock problem for girls

clue.text: Rushes from overnight sleeper boarding ship

clue.text: Perverts and drips oddly included in school tests

clue.text: A road around hollow cable produced a discharge

clue.text: Herald's quiet errors involved protecting copper

explanation.definitionFit: A precursor comes before something and announces it, as a herald does.

clue.text: The way workers fence a part of flower

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way

clue.text: Mensa seek changes — be logical!

clue.text: Having an accent under pressure

clue.text: Relax, accepting executed Arab leader as a consequence

clue.text: Gets all emotional, seeing first of kids being carried in new pouches

the first letter of kids is used

clue.text: Medicine needed after son's fall from horse

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for son

clue.text: Trustworthy Liberal getting lost touring Spain
